== Summary ==
Slip “•The Emperor’s Hand” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 500, 581, 1222)). Version [[The Emperor's Hand]] (Original). Not a recreation.
